policy: All30 original training engine/speaker strata, first lexicographic source ID for each of20phrases pervoice (600 total,120positive/480negative), samevoice first Hey Nick negative. Existing automatic command-prefix references, not phonetic truth. No selection by score. Speech-prefix versus equal-length zeros; negative source padded to480samples, then8000gap padded to480. Entire prefix has multiple480samples. Split at complete3feature call before target boundary; leftover frontend frame retained in suffix. Cross speech/silence frontend suffix with speech/silence neural prefix cache. All four final20000 GPUfloat arms, strict weights, no updates. Physical diagonal must reproduce unsplit full inference. Off-diagonals are artificial interventions, not deployable reset behavior. Preserve complete arrays/identities, fixed five-mean threshold, no dev/acceptance audio, no parameter search or qualification.
